title: Juicy Silky Polish Trout Pilaf
description: A rich and romantic Polish dish featuring trout, katsuramuki-cut, in a nut-free-friendly pilaf
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
Season the trout fillets with salt, black pepper, and dried parsley
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
Sear the trout fillets for 2 minutes on each side
Remove the trout from the skillet and set aside
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until softened
Add the sliced carrots to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes
Add the peas, white rice, and chicken broth to the skillet and stir to combine
Return the trout fillets to the skillet and cover with a lid
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15 minutes
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
